payload.text: ST0092 WP-10, owed in 3.3.0, RULED by vc 2026-11-11, received before ic read 10:51Z on date -u, on ic's reading (dc's find): intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/surface_check.sh refuses on main's own table because its hand-written INV map has no entry for INV-09 to INV-12. (2) One new arm beside the_two_flags_together_are_refused_rather_than_ranked: `edit --browser --path` and `edit --browser --editor` each refused with nothing on stdout (render.rs browsed() already refuses both; no test held it). It passes first run and its AT note says so, as AT-05.5 and AT-05.7 do. Then run the check green on a current binary in a WP-10 slot.
